# Espresso Machine Notes

## Current recipe

- dose: 18 grams
- yield: 36 grams
- target time: 28 to 32 seconds

## Troubleshooting

- sour shot: grind finer or raise brew temperature slightly
- bitter shot: grind coarser or shorten the extraction
- channeling: improve puck prep and reduce uneven tamp pressure

## Cleaning

- backflush with water after each session
- detergent backflush weekly
- soak the shower screen and basket monthly
